text:
lena-sales: FYI - AuroraHealth asked for a 3-week POC. Requirements: SAML SSO (encrypted assertions), SCIM push with groups->roles mapping, tenant RBAC, strict domain verification, audit export to Splunk, and optional customer-managed keys. Can we run Hosted for the trial? cc @omar-se @diego-eng @tara-sec

omar-se: Quick checklist: need IdP metadata (entityID, ACS URL, x509 cert, encryption cert), SCIM mapping CSV (group->role), confirm push vs pull, and Splunk HEC endpoint + token type.

diego-eng: Engineering notes: SCIM endpoints at /scim/v2/Users and /scim/v2/Groups, we support POST/PATCH/GET. Hosted POC rate-limit recommendation: <=100 SCIM ops/min. Encrypted SAML assertions OK but require their encryption cert. Hosted supports envelope encryption only; BYOK requires Private.

tara-sec: Security items: we can share SOC2 Type II and pen test summary. If they require CMK or FedRAMP controls, Private likely required. For Splunk, we can forward audit events via HTTPS (HEC) or syslog over TLS; ask about retention and PII redaction.

ops-bot: Tentative calendar hold created for AuroraHealth POC on 2025-04-01 09:00 UTC. React :white_check_mark: to confirm.

lena-sales: Next steps: I'll request IdP metadata, SCIM mapping CSV, and Splunk endpoint. Omar will prepare a sample SCIM token/curl and Diego will draft a short note on rate limits and BYOK constraints. Tara will start security questionnaire draft.

omar-se: Sample SCIM create for their reference: curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.com/scim/v2/Users" -H "Authorization: Bearer <SCIM_TOKEN>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"userName":"m.khan@aurorahealth.com","externalId":"ah-42","groups":[{"value":"clinician"}]}'

lena-sales: Thanks all, will post updates here when Aurora returns the mapping. :thumbsup:
